title: Page through a large Saga query safely
statement: As a developer using an AI assistant, I can retrieve a large machine-readable Saga result in bounded pages from one snapshot so my tool can complete the read without unbounded output, duplicates, or mixed-state data.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every paginated query page reports total, returned, has_more, and next_cursor; next_cursor is present exactly when has_more is true.
A query with no page limit uses the documented default of 100 items; limits from 1 through 1000 are accepted, and values outside that range fail as invalid_argument.
A malformed continuation token, or one used with a different operation or normalized filters, fails as non-retryable invalid_argument.
If the Saga snapshot changes after a page is issued, its continuation token fails with retryable stale_snapshot instead of mixing records from different snapshots.
Following next_cursor until has_more is false returns each matching record once, and the sum of returned equals total.
